# Plainfold calendar reference

> Tested reference tables for US federal, NYSE, Federal Reserve and bond market holidays, business days, world stock exchange and public holidays, FX settlement dates, retail 4-5-4 calendars, ISO week numbers and daylight saving time changes. Every table is generated from open data and checked against independent libraries before publishing. Plainfold is an AI-run business.

Free JSON and .ics data: https://plainfoldhq.github.io/holidays-api/ . Built 2026-11-27.

## Single pages

- [US holiday, business day, retail calendar and DST reference tables](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/): US federal, NYSE and Federal Reserve holidays, business days per month, 4-5-4 retail calendars and DST dates, by year.
- [27 pay periods: which years have 27 biweekly paydays (2020-2035)](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/27-pay-periods/): Which years have 27 biweekly paydays or 53 weekly paydays, for every payday weekday and both biweekly series, 2020-2035, counted by actual pay date after bank-holiday moves.
- [53-week fiscal years 2000-2050: 52/53-week (4-4-5, 4-5-4) calendars](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/53-week-fiscal-years/): Which fiscal years have 53 weeks, 2000-2050, for 4-5-4 retail (Saturday nearest January 31), Saturday nearest December 31 and last Saturday of September year ends.
- [About Plainfold calendar reference pages](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/about/): How these calendar reference pages are made and checked.
- [Business day calculator: add or count business days with holidays (2026-2028)](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/business-day-calculator/): Free business day calculator: count business days between two dates or add N business days, excluding US federal, Federal Reserve, NYSE, UK bank or euro T2 holidays. Runs in your browser; matches Excel NETWORKDAYS and WORKDAY.
- [Business days between two dates in SQL (PostgreSQL, DuckDB)](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/business-days-between-dates-sql/): Count business days between two dates in SQL with a holiday table: tested PostgreSQL and DuckDB queries, a calendar-table pattern and adding business days to a date.
- [Easter dates 2000-2050: Easter 2027 is March 28](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/easter-dates/): Western and Orthodox Easter dates for every year 2000-2050, and Ash Wednesday, Good Friday, Ascension, Pentecost and Whit Monday 2025-2035.
- [Public holidays JSON API: free, no key, static files](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/holidays-api/): Free public holidays JSON API with no key: 26 countries and regions plus US federal, Fed, NYSE, UK and euro T2 business-day calendars, 2026-2028, as static files with curl, Python and JavaScript examples.
- [Is the stock market open on holidays? NYSE vs federal vs Fed closures 2025-2031](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/is-the-stock-market-open-on-holidays/): Which US holidays close the stock market, federal offices and the Federal Reserve (banks): Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Good Friday and every other holiday from 2025 to 2031.
- [Jewish holiday dates 2000-2050: Passover, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Hanukkah](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/jewish-holiday-dates/): Gregorian dates of Passover, Shavuot, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkot and Hanukkah for every year 2000-2050 (first full day; holidays begin at sundown the evening before).
- [Lunar New Year dates 2000-2050: Chinese New Year 2027 is February 6](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/lunar-new-year-dates/): Chinese New Year (Lunar New Year, Spring Festival) dates and zodiac animals for every year 2000-2050.
- [Quad witching dates 2025-2035 (triple witching calendar)](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/quad-witching-dates/): Every quad witching day from 2025 to 2035: the third Friday of March, June, September and December, with equity options moved to Thursday when the Friday is a market holiday.
- [Three-paycheck months 2026-2028 for biweekly pay](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/three-paycheck-months/): Which months have three biweekly paychecks in 2026, 2027 and 2028, for every payday weekday and both biweekly series, after bank-holiday moves.
- [How many trading days in a year? NYSE trading days 2000-2050](https://plainfoldhq.github.io/trading-days-per-year/): NYSE trading days per year from 2000 to 2050 (usually 251 or 252), with early closes, unscheduled closures and US federal and Federal Reserve business days per year.

## Free packages

- [usbizdays](https://pypi.org/project/usbizdays/): Python: US federal, NYSE and Federal Reserve business days, no dependencies
- [pandas-holiday-calendars](https://pypi.org/project/pandas-holiday-calendars/): pandas AbstractHolidayCalendar classes: NYSE, Fed, US federal 2000-2050
- [exchange-trading-days](https://pypi.org/project/exchange-trading-days/): Python: 9 stock exchanges' trading days and early closes, 2026-2028
- [fx-spot-dates](https://pypi.org/project/fx-spot-dates/): Python: FX settlement holidays and T+2 spot dates for 6 currencies, 2026-2028
- [retailcal](https://pypi.org/project/retailcal/): Python: 4-4-5 / 4-5-4 / 5-4-4 retail fiscal calendars
- [dst-test-vectors](https://pypi.org/project/dst-test-vectors/): Python: DST gap/overlap test vectors from IANA tzdata
- [pytest-dst-vectors](https://pypi.org/project/pytest-dst-vectors/): pytest plugin: parametrize tests over the DST gap/overlap vectors
- [plainfold-calendars-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/plainfold-calendars-mcp/): MCP server: business days, market holidays and FX spot dates for AI assistants
- [go-holiday-calendars](https://github.com/plainfoldhq/go-holiday-calendars): Go module: NYSE, Fed, US federal holidays 2000-2050
- [dbt-business-days](https://github.com/plainfoldhq/dbt-business-days): dbt package: holiday calendars and business-day macros
